assets.layout: 2 columns × 2 rows: walnut, arcane cloth, parchment, copper
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production texture atlas for the Crownroad fantasy game's modal UI.
Primary request: create four beautiful hand-painted UI material textures in one square image, exact 2 by 2 equal quadrants, edge to edge with absolutely no gutters or separators. Each quadrant fills its whole allocated quarter.
Top left: warm dark walnut wooden horizontal planks, subtle carved grain and worn edges, brown amber highlights, spacious quiet interior for cream UI text. Planks must span full width.
Top right: deep royal violet and indigo magical fabric, soft arcane swirls and a few tiny gold flecks, richer purple towards edges, understated central area for white UI text.
Bottom left: warm light golden cream parchment paper, irregular subtle mottling, few faint faded ink flourishes near outer edges, very clean bright centre for dark brown text. No writing.
Bottom right: dark burnished bronze and copper forge plates, horizontal panel seams, subtle warm glowing highlights, quiet uncluttered centre for cream UI text.
Style/medium: premium cartoony fantasy strategy game UI, painterly bold shapes, pleasing vibrant material colour, charming organic irregularities, illustrated rather than photorealistic. Consistent lighting from upper left.
Constraints: texture assets only, no buttons, frames, icons, words, letters, symbols, interface mockup, characters, watermarks. Exactly equal quadrants with hard boundaries at horizontal and vertical halfway. No outside margins. Do not place anything that looks like text.

assets.layout: 3 columns × 2 rows: warband, spells, forge, adventure, caravan, community
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: a production illustration atlas for Crownroad, a vibrant medieval fantasy strategy game.
Primary request: six charming colourful hand-painted game illustrations, in exactly 3 columns by 2 rows of equal rectangular cells. Edge-to-edge cells with hard boundaries exactly at one-third and two-thirds of width and halfway height. No gutters, captions, UI frames or outside margins.
Top left: a knight's training courtyard, a large blue-and-gold heraldic shield and crossed swords prominently in the foreground, warm sunlight, crenellated castle and red pennants in background.
Top middle: a brilliant blue and violet magic orb floating above an open spell tome on a stone altar, swirling luminous runes with no readable lettering, purple magical library background.
Top right: a golden anvil and hammer, glowing forge coals, copper armour plates, orange and amber light.
Bottom left: a green forest adventure trail winding towards a hilltop fortress under a blue sky, gold expedition pennant.
Bottom middle: a charming colourful wooden medieval caravan wagon carrying treasure chests and supplies at a riverside camp, green-and-gold banners.
Bottom right: crossed royal crimson and blue tournament banners, a gleaming gold trophy, castle battlements and festive bunting.
Style: premium bold cartoon fantasy game illustration with confident dark outlines, saturated jewel colours, chunky readable silhouettes, hand painted highlights. Original artwork inspired by the cheerful fantasy UI mood of the user's game references. Illustrated not realistic, no 3D render.
Composition: each cell a complete independent landscape illustration, central objects large and readable as a cropped game panel vignette, balanced uncluttered composition. No characters.
Constraints: NO words, numbers, lettering, text, logo, watermark, borders, buttons or interface elements. Six equal full-bleed cells, 3 by 2. Landscape aspect ratio 3:2.
